title: Study on the characterization of SCN2A-associated movement disorders
summary: In this study, we aim to investigate which forms of movement disorders are associated with mutations in SCN2A. The goal of the project is to provide a description and record movement disorders in patients with SCN2A-related disorders.

interventions.name: In order to investigate movement disorders, we would like to collect video recordings of patients with SCN2A-related disorders, analyze them systematically, and evaluate them together with their phenotypic data.
